verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own marketing names revenue forecasting as a capability ("revenue forecasting? Check.") and describes sales pipeline tracking, so forecasting is a first-party claim. Nothing in the evidence explains how forecasts are built or whether they use stage probabilities and close dates, and no hands-on or community reports corroborate the feature. Missing for 10: documentation of forecast calculation from pipeline value, stage probability weighting, close-date-based forecast views or reports, independent corroboration.
